items.q: What is Prometey VPN and how does it work?
items.a: Prometey VPN is a service for security and freedom on the internet. We use modern protocols (VLESS and OpenVPN) to encrypt traffic and hide your real IP address from providers and websites.

items.q: Why are your protocols better than regular ones?
items.a: We use VLESS — one of the fastest and most 'invisible' protocols available today. It bypasses blocks where regular VPNs fail, while maintaining high speed.

items.q: On which devices can I use the VPN?
items.a: iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, routers, and Smart TV.

items.q: How many devices can I connect simultaneously?
items.a: Up to 10 devices on one subscription.

items.q: Do you have a free trial period?
items.a: Yes. No card required — try the service and decide for yourself.

items.q: What should I do if the key stops working?
items.a: Write to us in Telegram — we will update the key in a minute.
